summary: feat(settings): apply shared CMS styling to passkey password fallback
description:
Because:

- The passkey password fallback page ignored the shared CMS styling of the relying party.

This commit:

- Passes getCmsInfo() from the container to the page and the loading AppLayout.
- Passes cmsInfo to AppLayout and renders Continue with CmsButtonWithFallback.
- Adds a WithCms story and tests for the CMS and default button styles.

Closes FXA-13157
